title: Slide-and-Pass Lines
description: Partners slide sideways across the court together, passing back and forth while staying in a defensive-style stance — combining footwork and passing on the move.

content.objective: Catch and pass accurately while both players are moving sideways, keeping a low, balanced stance.
content.setup: Partners face each other three metres apart on the baseline, one ball per pair.
content.organization: Pairs go together; the next pair leaves at the free-throw line.
instructions: Both partners slide sideways up the court, facing each other.
Chest-pass back and forth while sliding, without crossing the feet.
At half court, switch to bounce passes.
At the far baseline, return with overhead passes.
Keep the gap constant at three metres.
coachingPoints: Pass slightly ahead of your partner's direction of travel.
Stay low: the stance is what makes the catch easy.
commonMistakes: Crossing the feet into a run.
Passing straight at the partner, so it arrives behind them.
Drifting apart and throwing longer passes.
content.safety: Pairs leave enough space so the next pair does not overlap; slide at jog speed.
progressions: Add a third player who chases and tries to deflect.
successCriteria: No dropped passes in a length.
content.gameApplication: Guards and wings pass while moving laterally around the perimeter; this builds that coordination early.
